title: Firm & Thick, Not Very Soft
text: Firm & Thick, Not Very Soft. Firm density, soft. . . That sort of contradicts itself. Is if firm or is it soft? It came vacuum packed, first time I've ever seen something that wasn't memory foam packed thst way. The pillow continues to get thicker and firmer. At first when it was thinner and softer I thought I could use it for a head pillow but as it thickened and firmed up it just wasn't compatible with my adjustable bed. I would raise the head of the bed and this pillow would force my head uncomfortably forward. But I do  use a pillow under each arm for comfort and this replaces an older pillow that was getting a bit flat. If you sleep flat on a bed and like a firm pillow that's not really all that soft this ma be the one for you.
